Build is clean now (exit 0, 0 errors). The remaining 8 warnings are just the bundler's own deprecation noise (Node API deprecations, unused exports, circular imports) — nothing actionable.

The two real bugs behind the link failure, both from the option-shape change in the new bundler:

- `src/core/options.js:7` — was reading `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands options as `{ retryCount }`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8-10` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the strict check only handled `true`/`false` and threw otherwise. Now treats `undefined` the same as `false` (backoff disabled).
